title: Thinking vs. Doing: Agents that Reason by Scaling Test-Time Interaction
authors_zh: Junhong Shen、Hao Bai、Lunjun Zhang、Yifei Zhou、Amrith Setlur、Shengbang Tong、Diego Caples、Nan Jiang、Tong Zhang、Ameet Talwalkar、Aviral Kumar
paper_type_zh: 网页智能体交互扩展与在线筛选式行为克隆研究
best_for_zh: 关注环境智能体轨迹数据、终局反馈、在线筛选、replay 与交互预算审计的研究者和工程师
one_line: TTI turns terminally successful multimodal web episodes into state/action behavior-cloning data under an expanding interaction horizon, but its public release omits trajectories and does not reproduce a clean paper-aligned split/configuration.
TTI 以终局成功筛选在线多模态网页 episode，再对其中的 state-action 步骤做 behavior cloning 并逐步扩大交互 horizon；但公开发布没有 rollout 语料，且划分、judge 与训练配置存在审计缺口。
why: It shows that the interaction budget changes which exploratory behaviors enter post-training data, and it provides a concrete case where terminal feedback, positive-only selection, evaluator identity, split integrity, and replay metadata must be audited together.
inclusion_reason: TTI makes interaction horizon a post-training data-selection variable: terminal environment/judge feedback selects successful on-policy web episodes whose state/action steps are behavior-cloned, while the incomplete rollout release and split/config drift expose important trajectory-audit boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The durable primary record is arXiv:2506.07976 v2 (2025-06-10). The paper also has SEA @ NeurIPS 2025 and ARLET workshop records, but the SEA page explicitly opts out of archival proceedings publication; this Card therefore records the venue as an arXiv preprint rather than a NeurIPS proceedings paper. The verified primary artifacts are the full paper and appendices, the official project page, the test-time-interaction/TTI repository pinned at commit 92ec04f5e4f2e4e40b99ecb1652191030a54a74a, and two author-linked Hugging Face checkpoints.

The paper asks whether a web agent can improve by increasing the number of environment interactions available at test time, rather than spending more reasoning tokens before each action. Extra interaction can expose new page state, permit backtracking, and support replanning, but a longer fixed horizon also creates aimless exploration and noisier attribution of terminal success. TTI turns that tension into a post-training data problem: which successful behaviors appear when the interaction horizon expands, and how should those episodes be selected and replayed?

One method-level episode begins with a task goal and URL. At each step the policy sees an accessibility tree, a set-of-marks screenshot, the latest three observations, and all previous actions, then emits chain-of-thought-bearing text ending in one of six browser actions: click, type, scroll, go back, Bing/search, or stop/ANSWER. The runtime record additionally carries the next observation, reward, done, final and optional reference answers, trajectory reward, Monte-Carlo return, and maximum horizon. An episode terminates when the agent stops or reaches the horizon; success is a binary terminal outcome. The public release is narrower: five task JSONL files, code, prompts/configuration, and two checkpoints are available, but the collected .pt rollout episodes, screenshots, replay manifest, and immutable environment snapshot are not.

This makes the work a core environment_agent_trajectory_data entry: state, action, observation, terminal predicate, evaluator identity, replay selection, and environment version all change the resulting supervision. It does not provide step-correctness labels, a general robotics result, or a reusable public rollout corpus. The Card reaches bilingual review depth through verified paper/repository evidence, while retaining the accepted L3_summary_ready metadata level because split integrity, evaluator pinning, licensing, and rollout availability remain unresolved.

可持续引用的 primary record 是 arXiv:2506.07976 v2（2025-06-10）。论文另有 SEA @ NeurIPS 2025 和 ARLET workshop 记录，但 SEA 页面明确选择不进入 archival proceedings；因此本 Card 将 venue 记为 arXiv preprint，而不是 NeurIPS proceedings paper。已核验的 primary artifacts 包括论文全文及附录、官方项目页、固定在 commit 92ec04f5e4f2e4e40b99ecb1652191030a54a74a 的 test-time-interaction/TTI 仓库，以及两个作者链接的 Hugging Face checkpoints。

论文研究的问题是：网页智能体能否通过增加测试时的环境交互次数来改进，而不是在每次行动前投入更多 reasoning tokens。更多交互可以暴露新的页面状态、允许回退并支持重新规划，但固定的长 horizon 也可能造成无目标探索，并让终局成功的归因更嘈杂。TTI 将这一矛盾转化为 post-training data 问题：当交互 horizon 扩大时会出现哪些成功行为，又应如何选择和 replay 这些 episodes？

在方法层面，一条 episode 从 task goal 和 URL 开始。每一步，policy 接收 accessibility tree、set-of-marks screenshot、最近三步 observation 和全部历史 actions，再输出带 chain-of-thought 的文本，并以六种浏览器动作之一结束：click、type、scroll、go back、Bing/search 或 stop/ANSWER。运行时记录还包含 next observation、reward、done、final answer、可选 reference answer、trajectory reward、Monte-Carlo return 和 maximum horizon。episode 在 agent 主动停止或达到 horizon 时终止；success 是二元的终局结果。公开发布的对象更窄：可获得五个 task JSONL 文件、代码、prompts/configuration 和两个 checkpoints，但没有收集到的 .pt rollout episodes、screenshots、replay manifest 或 immutable environment snapshot。

因此，该工作属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data 的核心条目：state、action、observation、terminal predicate、evaluator identity、replay selection 和 environment version 都会改变最终监督信号。它不提供 step-correctness labels，也不支持一般性的 robotics 结论，更没有发布可直接复用的 rollout corpus。Card 已用经核验的论文与仓库证据达到双语审阅深度，但保留 accepted metadata 中的 L3_summary_ready，因为 split integrity、evaluator pinning、licensing 和 rollout availability 仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
TTI's central contribution is to make interaction horizon a curriculum and data-selection variable: the current Gemma 3 12B policy rolls out web tasks online, terminal success selects whole episodes, and the action steps inside selected episodes become cross-entropy behavior-cloning targets. Although the paper places this under online RL and describes it as online STaR, the released update is positive-only filtered behavior cloning, not policy-gradient RLVR.

The supervision contract has two levels. At the episode level, reward is 1 for task success and 0 for failure; only non-empty trajectories with trajectory_reward > 0 survive, and code also drops terminal ANSWER [N/A]. At the state-action level, TrajectoryStepDataset flattens every retained episode into processed observation messages paired with the current policy's action text. Consequently, terminal feedback selects an episode but does not label which intermediate step was helpful, harmful, or merely tolerated by a successful outcome.

The feedback source is mixed rather than interchangeable. WebArena uses task-specific ground-truth evaluators whose released rows contain URL, string, or program/HTML evaluation specifications; this programmatic/environmental verifier can inspect the final task state but not the causal quality of each action. WebVoyager uses a prompted multimodal success judge over the task, final response, and screenshots. The paper identifies Gemma 3 27B and reports 88.9% accuracy against WebArena ground truth, but does not disclose class balance, calibration, or false-positive and false-negative rates. The score therefore supports the reported detector check, not a general claim that judged episodes are error-free.

The horizon curriculum begins at 10 interactions and increases multiplicatively toward 30. A replay buffer retains successful trajectories and emphasizes newer experience; in the released trainer, subsampling combines linear recency and inverse web-domain-frequency weights at alpha=0.5. This couples the learned data distribution to horizon, current-policy competence, evaluator decisions, domain frequency, and replay age.

The closest decision boundary is the paper's own contrast between "thinking" and "doing": increasing per-step reasoning effort or adding a prompted check-again pass is not the same intervention as obtaining new environment observations. Relative to a fixed long-horizon online baseline, TTI changes when long trajectories enter collection and training. The new data-facing element is the joint horizon curriculum, terminal-success filter, and replay-weighted state-action imitation; browser actions, chain-of-thought prompting, binary outcome evaluation, and behavior cloning are existing components assembled for this interaction-scaling question.

TTI 的核心贡献是把 interaction horizon 同时作为 curriculum 与 data-selection variable：当前 Gemma 3 12B policy 在线 rollout 网页任务，terminal success 在 episode 层面进行筛选，被选中 episode 内的 action steps 再成为 cross-entropy behavior-cloning targets。虽然论文把该方法放在 online RL 框架下并称为 online STaR，但公开实现的更新是 positive-only filtered behavior cloning，而不是 policy-gradient RLVR。

监督契约分为两个层级。在 episode 层面，任务成功 reward 为 1，失败为 0；代码只保留非空且 trajectory_reward > 0 的 trajectories，并丢弃以 ANSWER [N/A] 结束的记录。在 state-action 层面，TrajectoryStepDataset 将每条保留 episode 展平成 processed observation messages 与当前 policy action text 的配对。因此，terminal feedback 负责选择整条 episode，却不标注哪些中间步骤有帮助、有害，或只是被成功结果所容忍。

两套反馈来源是 mixed contract，不能互换。WebArena 使用 task-specific ground-truth evaluators；公开 task rows 包含 URL、string 或 program/HTML evaluation specifications。这类 programmatic/environmental verifier 能检查最终任务状态，却看不到每一步 action 的因果质量。WebVoyager 使用 prompted multimodal success judge，根据 task、final response 和 screenshots 作判断。论文指定 Gemma 3 27B，并报告其相对 WebArena ground truth 的 accuracy 为 88.9%，但未披露 class balance、calibration 或 false-positive/false-negative rates。因此，该数字只支持论文对 success detector 的检查，不能推出所有经 judge 接受的 episodes 都没有错误。

horizon curriculum 从 10 次交互开始，以乘法方式逐步增加到 30。replay buffer 保留成功 trajectories，并提高新近经验的权重；公开 trainer 在 subsampling 时，以 alpha=0.5 混合 linear recency weights 和 inverse web-domain-frequency weights。由此，训练数据分布同时受 horizon、current-policy competence、evaluator decisions、domain frequency 和 replay age 影响。

最接近的 decision boundary 是论文自身对“thinking”与“doing”的区分：提高每步 reasoning effort 或加入 prompted check-again pass，并不等同于获取新的 environment observations。相对于固定 long-horizon 的 online baseline，TTI 改变了长轨迹进入收集和训练的时机。其面向数据的变化在于把 horizon curriculum、terminal-success filter 和 replay-weighted state-action imitation 结合起来；browser actions、chain-of-thought prompting、binary outcome evaluation 与 behavior cloning 本身则是为 interaction-scaling 问题重新组合的已有组件。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. TTI trains separate agents for WebArena's self-hosted domains and WebVoyager's live websites. The paper reports 11K WebArena-domain tasks and 128K synthetically generated WebVoyager tasks. The pinned release instead contains 733 WebArena train rows and 128,072 WebVoyager train rows, so reproduction must not silently equate paper-scale collections with released files. The policy is google/gemma-3-12b-it. The exact exploratory task-generator model/checkpoint, its decoding settings, per-record lineage, rejection counts, and training temperature are unknown.

Online interaction. Per iteration, the paper reports sampling 512 tasks for rollout. The policy receives the task, URL, accessibility tree, set-of-marks screenshot, the latest three observations, and the entire action history. It emits thought plus one of six actions, then receives the browser's next observation. The environment loop stores observation, next_observation, reward, done, model action, info, answer and optional reference answer, and later attaches trajectory_reward, Monte-Carlo return, and max_steps. Episodes end on stop/ANSWER or the horizon.

Verification and filtering. WebArena runs task-specific ground-truth evaluators on the final state. WebVoyager sends the task, final answer, and screenshots to a prompted multimodal judge. The paper's full-scale detector is Gemma 3 27B; however, the released WebVoyager YAML pins only google/gemma-3-12b-it, and evaluation code calls the same agent.get_action object used for the policy. A paper-aligned evaluator checkpoint and invocation are therefore not reproducibly pinned. After collection, code saves trajectories locally, retains only non-empty episodes with positive terminal reward, removes terminal ANSWER [N/A], and flattens surviving steps for supervised learning. Failed episodes do not enter the loss.

Replay and curriculum. TTI starts with horizon 10 and raises it toward 30 so shorter successful behaviors enter training before longer exploration. The paper describes replay with greater weight on recent trajectories. The public trainer additionally mixes linear recency and inverse-domain-frequency sampling weights equally when it must subsample. The paper reports updating from 512 successful on-policy trajectories per iteration, but total attempts, success rates, duplicate counts, failed counts, and replay-buffer sizes are undisclosed.

Optimization and outputs. The loss maximizes the likelihood of retained action text given the processed state: cross-entropy behavior cloning with AdamW and WarmupCosineLR. Paper settings report WebArena at 10 iterations, learning rate 1e-6, batch size 4, gradient accumulation 2, four training GPUs, and evaluation horizon 30; WebVoyager reports 12 iterations, learning rate 4e-6, and six GPUs with the same core rollout/update counts. The public scripts drift: WebArena names two CUDA devices, while WebVoyager uses 15 iterations and four devices. A reproduction must choose and report either a paper-aligned or release-aligned configuration rather than merging them.

Released versus generated objects. Runtime code writes train_trajectories.pt and evaluate_trajectories.pt, but neither file nor an equivalent rollout/screenshot corpus is public. The official repository exposes five task JSONL files, training/evaluation code, prompts/configs, and links to TTI-WebVoyager and TTI-WebArena checkpoints. It provides no root LICENSE, GitHub tag, or GitHub release. Reproduction therefore requires regenerating episodes under pinned browser, website, WebArena image/database, evaluator, checkpoint, random-seed, dependency, and CUDA/runtime states; several of those pins remain unknown.

Inputs。TTI 分别为 WebArena self-hosted domains 和 WebVoyager live websites 训练 agents。论文报告了 11K 个 WebArena-domain tasks 和 128K 个 synthetically generated WebVoyager tasks；固定 commit 的公开发布则包含 733 条 WebArena train rows 和 128,072 条 WebVoyager train rows。因此，复现时不能默认论文规模的 collection 与公开文件完全相同。policy 是 google/gemma-3-12b-it。exploratory task-generator 的确切 model/checkpoint、decoding settings、逐记录 lineage、rejection counts 和训练 temperature 均为 unknown。

Online interaction。论文报告每次 iteration 抽取 512 个 tasks 进行 rollout。policy 接收 task、URL、accessibility tree、set-of-marks screenshot、最近三步 observations 和完整 action history；随后输出 thought 与六种 actions 之一，并获得浏览器的 next observation。environment loop 存储 observation、next_observation、reward、done、模型 action、info、answer 和可选 reference answer，之后再附加 trajectory_reward、Monte-Carlo return 与 max_steps。episode 在 stop/ANSWER 或达到 horizon 时结束。

Verification and filtering。WebArena 对 final state 运行 task-specific ground-truth evaluators。WebVoyager 将 task、final answer 与 screenshots 交给 prompted multimodal judge。论文的 full-scale detector 是 Gemma 3 27B；但公开 WebVoyager YAML 只固定了 google/gemma-3-12b-it，evaluation code 还调用与 policy 相同的 agent.get_action 对象。因此，paper-aligned evaluator checkpoint 与 invocation 并未被可复现地固定。收集完成后，代码先在本地保存 trajectories，再仅保留 terminal reward 为正的非空 episodes，移除 terminal ANSWER [N/A]，最后将保留步骤展平用于 supervised learning。失败 episodes 不进入 loss。

Replay and curriculum。TTI 从 horizon 10 开始并逐步提高到 30，使较短的成功行为先于更长的探索进入训练。论文描述 replay 时会提高近期 trajectories 的权重；公开 trainer 在必须 subsample 时，还等权混合 linear recency 与 inverse-domain-frequency sampling weights。论文报告每次 iteration 使用 512 条 successful on-policy trajectories 更新，但总尝试数、success rates、duplicate counts、failed counts 和 replay-buffer sizes 均未披露。

Optimization and outputs。loss 在 processed state 条件下最大化被保留 action text 的似然，即使用 AdamW 和 WarmupCosineLR 的 cross-entropy behavior cloning。论文设置中，WebArena 运行 10 iterations，learning rate 为 1e-6，batch size 为 4，gradient accumulation 为 2，使用四张 training GPUs，evaluation horizon 为 30；WebVoyager 报告 12 iterations、learning rate 4e-6 和六张 GPUs，核心 rollout/update counts 相同。公开 scripts 存在漂移：WebArena 只列出两个 CUDA devices，而 WebVoyager 使用 15 iterations 和四个 devices。复现应明确选择并报告 paper-aligned 或 release-aligned configuration，而不能将二者混成一套设置。

Released versus generated objects。运行时代码会写出 train_trajectories.pt 与 evaluate_trajectories.pt，但这两个文件以及等价的 rollout/screenshot corpus 都未公开。官方仓库提供五个 task JSONL 文件、training/evaluation code、prompts/configs，并链接 TTI-WebVoyager 与 TTI-WebArena checkpoints；仓库没有 root LICENSE、GitHub tag 或 GitHub release。因此，复现必须重新生成 episodes，并固定 browser、website、WebArena image/database、evaluator、checkpoint、random seed、dependency 与 CUDA/runtime states；其中多项 pin 仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The reported evidence covers controlled interaction studies and full TTI training, but it does not independently validate the released data as a complete corpus. WebVoyager evaluation contains 427 tasks across 13 domains, and full WebArena contains 812 tasks. The preliminary WebArena interaction study reports a random 62-task analysis/test subset and the remaining 750 tasks for online training; the exact IDs and seed for that split are not published as a manifest.

In the paper's controlled studies, increasing the opportunity to interact can outperform spending the same intervention on repeated per-step reasoning, because new actions reveal new observations. The benefit is not monotonic under every mechanism: repeatedly prompting the agent to check again can turn correct responses into incorrect ones, while a fixed long horizon can produce aimless exploration and noisy credit assignment. These negative results motivate the curriculum rather than proving that longer episodes are intrinsically higher-quality data.

For the full comparison, Table 3 reports 64.8% average WebVoyager success for the TTI Gemma 3 12B agent. The authors describe it as the strongest aggregate result among the compared open-weight agents trained on open-source synthetic data. That is a model/benchmark result under the paper's comparison scope; it has not been independently reproduced here and does not establish trajectory correctness, split cleanliness, judge calibration, licensing, or corpus completeness.

The paper also reports 88.9% success-detector accuracy when the prompted WebVoyager judge is checked against WebArena ground truth. This supports using the detector in the reported experiment, but aggregate accuracy without class balance, confusion counts, calibration, or adversarial tests cannot quantify false acceptance of failed trajectories or false rejection of successful ones. WebArena's programmatic ground-truth evaluators avoid that particular learned-judge dependency, yet they still supply only terminal outcome feedback and can inherit environment or task-specification brittleness.

The official release supplies implementation evidence for the data pipeline: runtime transition fields, positive filtering, state-action flattening, replay selection, scripts/configs, and two trained checkpoints can be inspected. It does not supply the successful and failed rollouts consumed by training. Therefore the strongest supported conclusion is mechanistic: TTI demonstrates a concrete loop in which interaction budget changes the pool of successful on-policy behavior available for BC. Benchmark performance is not evidence that the selected data is broadly high-quality or safely reusable.

论文证据覆盖受控的 interaction studies 和完整 TTI training，但没有独立证明公开数据构成完整语料。WebVoyager evaluation 包含 13 个 domains 上的 427 个 tasks，完整 WebArena 包含 812 个 tasks。初步 WebArena interaction study 报告随机抽取 62 个 tasks 作为 analysis/test subset，并将其余 750 个用于 online training；该 split 的确切 IDs 和 seed 没有作为 manifest 发布。

在论文的受控研究中，增加交互机会可以优于把同类干预用于重复的 per-step reasoning，因为新的 actions 会带来新的 observations。但收益并非对所有机制都单调：反复提示 agent 再检查一次可能把正确回答改成错误回答，而固定 long horizon 可能导致无目标探索和 noisy credit assignment。这些 negative results 为 curriculum 提供了动机，却不能证明更长 episodes 天然就是更高质量的数据。

在完整比较中，Table 3 报告 TTI Gemma 3 12B agent 的 WebVoyager average success 为 64.8%。作者将其描述为比较范围内、使用 open-source synthetic data 训练的 open-weight agents 中最强的 aggregate result。该数字是论文特定比较范围内的 model/benchmark result；本次整理没有独立复现，也不能证明 trajectory correctness、split cleanliness、judge calibration、licensing 或 corpus completeness。

论文还报告：将 prompted WebVoyager judge 与 WebArena ground truth 对照时，success-detector accuracy 为 88.9%。这一结果支持在所报告实验中使用该 detector，但只有 aggregate accuracy、缺少 class balance、confusion counts、calibration 和 adversarial tests，无法量化对失败 trajectories 的 false acceptance，或对成功 trajectories 的 false rejection。WebArena 的 programmatic ground-truth evaluators 不依赖这一 learned judge，但仍只提供 terminal outcome feedback，也可能受到 environment 或 task-specification brittleness 的影响。

官方发布为数据流程提供了可检查的 implementation evidence：可以审计 runtime transition fields、positive filtering、state-action flattening、replay selection、scripts/configs 和两个 trained checkpoints；但训练实际使用的成功与失败 rollouts 没有发布。因此，最强的受支持结论是机制性的：TTI 展示了一条具体闭环，其中 interaction budget 改变了可用于 BC 的 successful on-policy behavior pool。benchmark performance 不能作为所选数据具有普遍高质量或可安全复用的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's prior-work baseline is test-time scaling that allocates more tokens or repeated reasoning to a single decision, plus online agent training under a fixed interaction budget. TTI changes the scaling axis: it treats environment actions and the new observations they unlock as the test-time resource, then couples that resource to training through an expanding-horizon curriculum.

The concrete data innovation is not a new browser action language or a new per-step verifier. It is the selection pipeline current-policy rollout -> terminal success -> successful-episode replay -> per-step action likelihood, with the permitted horizon raised from 10 toward 30 and recent/domain-balanced sampling shaping replay. This makes the collected supervision non-stationary: later iterations can include behaviors that earlier horizons could not express, while the replay buffer controls which earlier successes remain visible.

The distinction from RLVR matters. A verifier does produce binary terminal reward, but the optimizer does not apply a policy-gradient objective to successful and failed returns. It discards failures and maximizes cross-entropy on actions from retained successes. Calling the released recipe sft plus agent_training preserves the actual data path and avoids treating any verifier-filtered update as RLVR.

The paper also separates two feedback interfaces within one recipe. WebArena's programmatic ground-truth evaluation checks final task state; WebVoyager's prompted multimodal judge estimates success from responses and screenshots. The shared binary output hides different error surfaces, so evaluator identity must travel with every episode or checkpoint lineage record. This is a useful direction signal for reasoning-data research: interaction scaling cannot be audited from horizon alone; feedback provenance and replay selection determine what the longer interaction budget teaches.

What is not new includes chain-of-thought prompting, behavior cloning, replay buffers, browser environments, and binary terminal evaluation. The result is best understood as an integration and scaling study with a specific curriculum. Before reuse, verify the exact split manifest, task-generator lineage, successful/failed episode counts, evaluator checkpoint and prompt, paper-versus-script settings, environment snapshot, and artifact licenses. Without those checks, neither the novelty claim nor the benchmark gain licenses reconstruction of the reported data distribution.

论文的 prior-work baseline 包括：把更多 tokens 或重复 reasoning 分配给单次决策的 test-time scaling，以及在固定 interaction budget 下进行的 online agent training。TTI 改变了 scaling axis：它把 environment actions 及其带来的新 observations 视为 test-time resource，再通过 expanding-horizon curriculum 将该资源与训练耦合。

具体的数据创新并不是新的 browser action language 或新的 per-step verifier，而是 current-policy rollout -> terminal success -> successful-episode replay -> per-step action likelihood 这条选择流水线；允许的 horizon 从 10 逐步增加到 30，replay 又受到 recency/domain-balanced sampling 的塑形。由此，收集到的监督是 non-stationary 的：后期 iterations 可以包含早期 horizon 无法表达的行为，而 replay buffer 决定哪些早期成功仍会被训练看到。

它与 RLVR 的区别十分重要。verifier 确实产生 binary terminal reward，但 optimizer 并未对成功与失败 returns 使用 policy-gradient objective；它丢弃失败，只对保留成功中的 actions 最大化 cross-entropy。将公开 recipe 记为 sft 加 agent_training，才能保留真实 data path，并避免把所有经过 verifier 筛选的更新都当作 RLVR。

论文还在同一 recipe 中区分了两种反馈接口。WebArena 的 programmatic ground-truth evaluation 检查 final task state；WebVoyager 的 prompted multimodal judge 根据 responses 和 screenshots 估计 success。二者共享的 binary output 掩盖了不同的 error surfaces，因此 evaluator identity 必须伴随每条 episode 或 checkpoint lineage record。这对 reasoning-data research 是一个方向信号：不能只根据 horizon 审计 interaction scaling；feedback provenance 与 replay selection 共同决定更长 interaction budget 实际教会了什么。

并非新贡献的组件包括 chain-of-thought prompting、behavior cloning、replay buffers、browser environments 和 binary terminal evaluation。该工作更适合被理解为带特定 curriculum 的 integration and scaling study。复用前仍需核验 exact split manifest、task-generator lineage、successful/failed episode counts、evaluator checkpoint 与 prompt、paper-versus-script settings、environment snapshot 和 artifact licenses。在这些检查完成前，novelty claim 与 benchmark gain 都不足以授权重建论文所用的数据分布。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Method and credit assignment. Positive-only episode filtering provides no process label for intermediate actions. A successful episode can contain redundant searches, accidental recoveries, or actions that would fail under a slightly different page state, yet every retained action becomes a positive BC target. Conversely, failed episodes that contain useful partial progress are excluded from the loss. The curriculum changes achievable behavior but does not solve this terminal-credit ambiguity.

Verifier and judge risk. WebVoyager's prompted judge can produce false positives and false negatives; the reported 88.9% aggregate accuracy leaves calibration, class balance, and attack robustness unknown. The public release does not pin the paper's Gemma 3 27B evaluator and instead exposes a 12B config plus code that reuses the policy's agent.get_action path. WebArena's programmatic evaluators are more direct but remain tied to task specifications and environment state, and neither feedback path establishes step correctness. The paper itself observes that repeated checking can harm correct answers, that the agent can over-rely on Bing resets, and that final-step self-verification can miss constraints such as a required repository year.

Split and lineage risk. In the pinned release, all 733 WebArena train IDs/questions also appear in the 812-row test file, although endpoint fields differ. This proves that the default released files do not encode a clean train/test task separation; it does not prove that the paper's original run used the same file state. WebVoyager's 128,072 train rows contain 104,756 unique (web_name, question) pairs but only 3,184 unique IDs. The 337 IDs shared with test are lineage-key collisions, not direct task contamination, because no exact (web_name, question) pair overlaps. Exact paper-run split IDs, random seeds, generator lineage, deduplication rules, and rejection statistics remain unknown.

Release and replay risk. The repository publishes tasks, code, configs, and two checkpoints, not train_trajectories.pt, evaluate_trajectories.pt, screenshots, successful/failed rollout manifests, or an immutable browser/environment snapshot. Live WebVoyager sites can change through content, cookies, layout, availability, or browser behavior; WebArena also requires pinned images and database state. The absence of raw and rejected episodes blocks independent audit of reward errors, domain weighting, replay age, and dropped failures.

Configuration and rights risk. Paper and scripts disagree on material settings: WebVoyager is 12 iterations/six GPUs in the paper versus 15 iterations/four devices in the public script; WebArena reports four GPUs while its script names two devices. The GitHub repository has no root LICENSE, tag, or release. Hugging Face checkpoint metadata says MIT, but that does not resolve upstream Gemma terms or rights in task text, website content, or screenshots. Privacy/consent and redaction procedures are unknown. Experiments cover web agents only; robotics and open-world computer use remain future work, and Table 3/Table 4 have not been independently reproduced for this Card.

Method and credit assignment。positive-only episode filtering 不为中间 actions 提供 process labels。成功 episode 可能包含冗余搜索、偶然恢复，或在页面状态略有变化时就会失败的动作，但其中每个保留 action 都会成为正向 BC target。相反，包含有用局部进展的失败 episodes 不进入 loss。curriculum 改变了可达到的行为，却没有解决这种 terminal-credit ambiguity。

Verifier and judge risk。WebVoyager 的 prompted judge 可能产生 false positives 与 false negatives；已报告的 88.9% aggregate accuracy 没有揭示 calibration、class balance 或 attack robustness。公开发布没有固定论文中的 Gemma 3 27B evaluator，而只提供 12B config，以及复用 policy agent.get_action 路径的代码。WebArena 的 programmatic evaluators 更直接，但仍绑定 task specifications 和 environment state；两种反馈路径都不能建立 step correctness。论文还观察到：repeated checking 可能损害原本正确的答案，agent 可能过度依赖 Bing resets，final-step self-verification 也可能遗漏“仓库年份必须满足要求”之类约束。

Split and lineage risk。在固定 commit 的公开发布中，全部 733 个 WebArena train IDs/questions 都出现在 812-row test file 中，虽然 endpoint fields 不同。这证明默认公开文件没有编码干净的 train/test task separation，但不能证明论文原始运行使用了完全相同的文件状态。WebVoyager 的 128,072 条 train rows 包含 104,756 个 unique (web_name, question) pairs，却只有 3,184 个 unique IDs。与 test 共享的 337 个 IDs 属于 lineage-key collisions，并非直接 task contamination，因为没有 exact (web_name, question) pair 重叠。paper-run split IDs、random seeds、generator lineage、deduplication rules 和 rejection statistics 仍为 unknown。

Release and replay risk。仓库公开 tasks、code、configs 和两个 checkpoints，但没有 train_trajectories.pt、evaluate_trajectories.pt、screenshots、successful/failed rollout manifests 或 immutable browser/environment snapshot。live WebVoyager sites 会随内容、cookies、layout、availability 或 browser behavior 变化；WebArena 同样需要固定 images 与 database state。缺少 raw 与 rejected episodes，导致外部无法独立审计 reward errors、domain weighting、replay age 和 dropped failures。

Configuration and rights risk。论文与 scripts 在关键设置上不一致：WebVoyager 在论文中是 12 iterations/六张 GPUs，在公开 script 中则是 15 iterations/四个 devices；WebArena 论文报告四张 GPUs，但 script 只列出两个 devices。GitHub 仓库没有 root LICENSE、tag 或 release。Hugging Face checkpoint metadata 声明 MIT，但这不能解决 upstream Gemma terms，也不能覆盖 task text、website content 或 screenshots 的权利。privacy/consent 和 redaction procedures 均为 unknown。实验只覆盖 web agents；robotics 与 open-world computer use 仍是 future work，Table 3/Table 4 也未针对本 Card 被独立复现。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment_agent_trajectory_data track, TTI is most useful as a construction and audit recipe, not as a downloadable training-trajectory dataset. A builder can reproduce the modular flow—task source, multimodal browser state, policy action, terminal evaluator, positive-episode filter, state-action serializer, replay sampler, and horizon scheduler—while recording evaluator identity and environment version as first-class lineage fields.

The Card suggests four concrete track-level uses. First, use TTI as a filtered-BC baseline when comparing fixed versus expanding interaction horizons; do not label that baseline RLVR. Second, log both episode-level terminal reward and step-level serialization so later audits can distinguish the selection unit from the loss unit. Third, keep WebArena programmatic evaluation and WebVoyager prompted judging as separate feedback adapters with separate version, calibration, and error records. Fourth, design a replay manifest that includes task ID, site/domain, policy checkpoint, evaluator checkpoint/prompt, horizon, seed, collection iteration, terminal outcome, retention decision, and recency/domain sampling weight.

It is also a useful negative-control checklist. Preserve failed and ANSWER [N/A] episodes outside the training loss; compare positive-only BC with a policy that can learn from failures; report raw attempts, successful episodes, unique tasks, duplicates, replay occupancy, and per-domain selection rates; and test whether gains persist under a clean task split and a separately pinned judge. These experiments would locate whether the gain comes from interaction opportunity, curriculum ordering, success filtering, replay composition, or evaluator errors.

Reuse class: reading/audit and code-level reproduction reference only. The task JSONL files can be inspected, and the two checkpoints can support carefully licensed evaluation, but training-data reuse is blocked pending an explicit code/task license, clean paper-aligned split manifest, pinned Gemma 3 27B judge and prompt, released rollout/screenshot lineage, and reproducible environment snapshot. Benchmark scores alone do not remove those blockers.

对于 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，TTI 最适合作为 construction and audit recipe，而不是可下载的 training-trajectory dataset。构建者可以复现其模块化流程：task source、multimodal browser state、policy action、terminal evaluator、positive-episode filter、state-action serializer、replay sampler 和 horizon scheduler；同时应将 evaluator identity 与 environment version 作为一等 lineage fields 记录。

这张 Card 提供四种具体的 track-level 用法。第一，用 TTI 作为 filtered-BC baseline，比较 fixed 与 expanding interaction horizons，但不要把该 baseline 标为 RLVR。第二，同时记录 episode-level terminal reward 与 step-level serialization，让后续审计能够区分 selection unit 和 loss unit。第三，把 WebArena programmatic evaluation 与 WebVoyager prompted judging 作为两个独立 feedback adapters，分别维护 version、calibration 和 error records。第四，设计 replay manifest，至少包含 task ID、site/domain、policy checkpoint、evaluator checkpoint/prompt、horizon、seed、collection iteration、terminal outcome、retention decision 以及 recency/domain sampling weight。

它也可作为 useful negative-control checklist。应在 training loss 之外保留 failed 与 ANSWER [N/A] episodes；比较 positive-only BC 与能够利用 failures 的 policy；报告 raw attempts、successful episodes、unique tasks、duplicates、replay occupancy 和 per-domain selection rates；并测试在 clean task split 与单独固定 judge 后，收益是否仍然存在。这些实验可以定位增益究竟来自 interaction opportunity、curriculum ordering、success filtering、replay composition，还是 evaluator errors。

复用等级：仅限 reading/audit 与 code-level reproduction reference。task JSONL 文件可以检查，两个 checkpoints 也可在谨慎核验许可后用于 evaluation；但 training-data reuse 仍被以下事项阻断：明确的 code/task license、干净且 paper-aligned 的 split manifest、固定的 Gemma 3 27B judge 与 prompt、已发布的 rollout/screenshot lineage，以及可复现的 environment snapshot。benchmark scores 本身不能消除这些 blockers。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3 and 5 plus Algorithm 1 first: the decisive mechanism is terminal-success selection followed by state-action cross-entropy, so the released recipe is filtered BC/online STaR rather than RLVR.
  • Keep the feedback paths separate: WebArena uses task-specific programmatic ground truth, whereas WebVoyager uses a prompted multimodal judge reported as Gemma 3 27B; neither provides step-correctness labels.
  • Audit paper and release as different objects: the repository publishes five task JSONL files, code/configs, and two checkpoints, but no rollout corpus, screenshots, or replay manifest.
  • Treat the released WebArena split as unsafe by default because all 733 train IDs/questions occur in the 812-row test file; this release finding does not prove the original paper run used that exact split.
  • Reconcile evaluator, iteration, and GPU settings before reproduction, and inspect the failure analyses on repeated checking, long-horizon wandering, Bing resets, and weak final-step self-verification.

• 优先阅读 Sections 3、5 和 Algorithm 1：关键机制是 terminal-success selection 后进行 state-action cross-entropy，因此公开 recipe 属于 filtered BC/online STaR，而不是 RLVR。
  • 必须区分两条反馈路径：WebArena 使用 task-specific programmatic ground truth，WebVoyager 使用论文报告为 Gemma 3 27B 的 prompted multimodal judge；二者都不提供 step-correctness labels。
  • 应把论文与发布当作不同对象审计：仓库公开五个 task JSONL 文件、code/configs 和两个 checkpoints，但没有 rollout corpus、screenshots 或 replay manifest。
  • 默认将公开 WebArena split 视为不安全，因为全部 733 个 train IDs/questions 都出现在 812-row test file 中；这一发布审计结果不能证明原始论文运行使用了完全相同的 split。
  • 复现前应对齐 evaluator、iteration 和 GPU settings，并阅读 repeated checking、long-horizon wandering、Bing resets 与 weak final-step self-verification 的 failure analyses。

The paper reports 128K synthetically generated WebVoyager tasks and 11K tasks for WebArena self-hosted domains. The pinned release contains 128,072 WebVoyager train rows and 733 WebArena train rows, so paper and release scales must be kept distinct.
Task goal, URL, accessibility tree, and set-of-marks screenshot; observation history is truncated to the latest three steps while all past actions remain available.
One of click, type, scroll, go back, Bing/search, or stop/ANSWER, preceded by the paper's chain-of-thought prompt format.
The current Gemma 3 12B policy generates its own chain-of-thought-bearing browser actions online; no external teacher supplies the retained action targets.
Self-hosted WebArena domains and live WebVoyager websites, using accessibility-tree plus screenshot observations and browser actions.

WebArena uses task-specific ground-truth evaluators over final state. WebVoyager uses a prompted multimodal success judge over the task, final response, and screenshots; the paper identifies Gemma 3 27B and reports 88.9% accuracy against WebArena ground truth.
Binary episode outcome, 1 for task success and 0 otherwise; it filters full trajectories and is not a step-correctness label.
The agent emits stop/ANSWER or reaches the maximum horizon; a successful terminal state must also pass the applicable WebArena evaluator or WebVoyager prompted judge.

Five task JSONL files, training/evaluation code, prompts/configs, and two HF checkpoints are public. No collected training/evaluation rollout corpus, screenshot bundle, replay manifest, or immutable environment snapshot is released.
Benchmark or synthetic task -> current-policy browser interaction -> terminal evaluator/judge -> positive-episode filter -> per-step state/action BC examples -> updated policy.

A single multimodal policy acts in a six-action browser interface with CoT prompting. No external retrieval or action verifier is used by the controlled Section 4 agent; TTI adds a replay buffer, success filter, and horizon scheduler.
Binary terminal success greater than zero.

Retain non-empty episodes with trajectory_reward > 0; discard episodes ending in ANSWER [N/A]; then flatten retained episodes into message/action examples. The default top_p=1 length filter does not remove additional successful episodes.

Interaction curriculum increases from horizon 10 toward 30 and evaluation uses horizon 30. Released configs set max_new_tokens to 1024; total token, wall-clock, and website-query budgets are not fully disclosed.

Cross-entropy behavior cloning over retained state/action steps with AdamW and WarmupCosineLR. The released trainer mixes linear recency and inverse-domain-frequency sampling weights at 0.5 each when subsampling replay trajectories.

WebArena reports 10 iterations, 512 rollouts and 512 update trajectories per iteration, learning rate 1e-6, batch size 4, gradient accumulation 2, four training GPUs, and evaluation horizon 30. WebVoyager reports 12 iterations, learning rate 4e-6, six GPUs, and otherwise the same core batch/rollout settings.
Official arXiv v2/full appendix, project page, code/task repository at commit 92ec04f5e4f2e4e40b99ecb1652191030a54a74a, two author-linked HF checkpoints, and non-archival workshop OpenReview records.

The paper's preliminary WebArena study states 62 random test tasks and 750 non-test training tasks. Full evaluation uses 812 WebArena and 427 WebVoyager tasks; a 78-task WebVoyager subset tracks training progress. Exact clean split IDs for the paper runs are not published as a manifest.

At the pinned release, all 733 WebArena train IDs/questions also appear in the 812-row test file, differing in endpoint fields; the default release therefore does not encode a clean task split. WebVoyager train/test share 337 IDs but zero exact (web_name, question) pairs, so those ID collisions alone are not evidence of direct question contamination.

The paper trains separate WebVoyager and WebArena agents to avoid mixing real-domain and self-hosted synthetic environments, but no general lexical/semantic decontamination or task-deduplication procedure is disclosed.

Runtime code saves all collected episodes locally before training but filters training to positive episodes. Neither the successful nor failed runtime trajectory files are publicly released, so failure retention cannot be audited from artifacts.

items: Positive-only terminal filtering provides no credit assignment for which intermediate actions helped or hurt and can reinforce spurious actions within successful episodes.
The prompted WebVoyager judge can produce false positives or false negatives; 88.9% aggregate accuracy does not disclose class balance, calibration, or adversarial robustness.
The paper reports that repeated check-again prompting can turn correct answers into incorrect ones and that fixed long horizons can cause aimless exploration.
The paper observes over-reliance on Bing resets and limited final-step self-verification, including choosing a 2021 repository for a task requiring 2022.
Live websites, cookies, page changes, browser versions, and unavailable service endpoints make trajectories brittle to replay.

The paper names a Gemma 3 27B evaluator, while the released WebVoyager config pins only the 12B policy and the code calls the same agent for evaluation; the paper evaluator is not reproducibly pinned.
